quote: In this paper, we develop a novel inference-time defense, named CLEANGEN, against backdoor attacks on generation tasks in LLMs.

We evaluate the effectiveness, helpfulness, and efficiency of CLEANGEN against five state-of-theart (SOTA) backdoor attacks: VPI-Sentiment Steering, VPI-Code Injection, AutoPoison, Chat-Backdoor (Multi-Turn), and Chat-Backdoor (Single Turn).
